title: Same Ads, Every Market
description: Corporate sends one-size-fits-all creative. Your franchisees in Phoenix and Portland get the same ad. That's why CPL keeps climbing.

title: No Visibility Into What Works
description: Franchisors can't see which locations are winning or losing. Decisions are based on gut feeling, not data.

title: No Way to Measure What Works
description: Your franchisees are spending money every month with no clear dashboard showing which locations are winning, which creative is converting, or where budget is being wasted.
